No. The 67.7 ha tree-cover loss was recorded in **2020**, before the EUDR cut-off date of 31 December 2020.

No loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected on the property from 2021 through 2025. The data did show 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches in 2021. Small or narrow changes may be missed, and this assessment does not establish EUDR compliance.
